profile_text.body:
Character.AI operates a consumer chat platform that allows users to converse with a large variety of AI-driven personas. The company describes its service as "AI Chat, Reimagined" and positions its app as the number one AI chat application, though that claim originates from the company's own site. The core product, Character.ai, falls in the chat and general large language model category and is oriented around persona-based conversations.

The held facts note that the Character.ai product carries a recognized risk profile around HR and appropriate use, reflecting concerns about how persona chat applications may be deployed or experienced by users. No litigation, patent filings, MCP server registrations, or SEC disclosures appear in the available data.
